name: Sweetsprings
description: Untouched and majestic is the common definition of the capital of the spring elves in Sindile by foreign visitors. Divided into levels, its floors are like rings surrounding the colossal tree trunks, interconnected by bridges or elevators. Its construction is so complex that it blends with the very branches and leaves of the trees to the point that a distracted traveler on the ground may not even realize the presence of the city. They use equipment crafted from breithwood to transport themselves and goods through the levels, some methods very curious. Only the Council, priests and elementalists are allowed to access the upper levels, where the sunlight reaches the city more intensively. The Council of Guardians meets with the king and queen in a fancy hall called Breith’s cocoon, which is sacred to them. Foreigners are typically confined to the city’s lower levels, under strong vigilance. There have been heated debates since Sedura was invited into the structure, as many believe she would destroy the purity of the place. To make things worse, one of the trees died soon after, fueling debates about desecration. Some guardians believe that was an action by the Eternal Circle, but could not confirm. The king often speaks slowly and explains things to foreigners as though he’s speaking to children, so any meeting with him requires extra patience and diplomacy.
